text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.760.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.760.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain memory is added to this agent and works. A note was saved and read back with real GBrain calls, but a fresh OpenClaw chat hasn't used it yet, because gbrain's tools load when a session starts.

**What I did**
- **Installed GBrain release v0.60.760.0** (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.760.0`) using Bun 1.4.5. `gbrain --version` prints `0.60.760.0`.
- **Created a keyless brain** with `gbrain init --pglite --no-embedding` and finished its setup steps. There are no API keys, and no searches or notes are sent to an outside provider. Search is keyword-only for now.
- **Connected it to OpenClaw:** I registered gbrain as a memory server in `openclaw.json`, then ran `gbrain setup openclaw`. That added a "check GBrain first" plugin that runs on every message.
  - Setup first reported that plugin as not loaded. OpenClaw's own check then showed it loaded, and setup's suggested fix rerun confirmed it is installed and enabled.
- **Your identity and instructions are unchanged.** The model and other agent settings are as they were. `/workspace` had no `AGENTS.md`, so setup created one containing only gbrain's marked block. OpenClaw also removed the comments from `openclaw.json` when it saved the new server; the settings themselves are intact.

**Remember/recall check**
- **Command line:** I saved a test fact with provenance `install-check`, recalled it from a new process, and found it with a plain keyword search.
- **Through OpenClaw's server setup:** I started the same server command OpenClaw uses. The connection worked and listed gbrain's 8 memory tools. I saved a second test fact, then started a new server process and recalled it; both facts came back.
- The first save through the server was refused because it used an option this connection doesn't allow. Nothing was written, and the retry without it worked.

**Search mode (you can change it any time; nothing is waiting on you)**
In effect: **conservative**. It was picked automatically because there's no chat API key and no reranker.

```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

1. **conservative:** 4K budget, at most 10 results, no reranker. Best for low cost or high volume.
2. **balanced:** 12K budget, 25 results, reranked.
3. **tokenmax:** no budget, 50 results, reranked. The widest search; recommended once you add a chat key.

These are estimates of input cost to the model you run, not prices for your plan. Query expansion is off in every mode. Change mode with `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>` and check it with `gbrain search modes`.

**Other settings in effect**
- **Auto-saving facts:** off, so I only save what you ask me to remember. `salient` is recommended: `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback salient`.
- **Free upkeep:** on while the gbrain session is open. Turn it off with `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive:** on. It keeps one redacted page per conversation per day, and nothing leaves this machine without a key. Turn it off with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
- **Not set up:** API keys, automatic capture, scheduled jobs and background services.

**One step left:** start a new OpenClaw session (restart the gateway if it's running) and ask it to recall "gbrain install check". When it answers, have it `forget` both `install-check` facts.

GBrain also offers a hosted version at gbrain.io: one always-on brain shared by all your agents. Your local install doesn't need it.
